service_field_options_ck.name: service_field_options_ck
service_field_options_ck.value: ("service_field_definition"."field_type" = 'SELECT') = ("service_field_definition"."options" is not null) and ("service_field_definition"."options" is null or jsonb_typeof("service_field_definition"."options") = 'array')

service_item_definition_unit_ck.name: service_item_definition_unit_ck
service_item_definition_unit_ck.value: "service_item_definition"."unit" is null or (char_length("service_item_definition"."unit") between 1 and 20 and "service_item_definition"."unit" = btrim("service_item_definition"."unit"))

project_session_time_ck.name: project_session_time_ck
project_session_time_ck.value: "project_session"."end_time" is null or ("project_session"."start_time" is not null and "project_session"."end_time" > "project_session"."start_time")

gallery_expiry_one_ck.name: gallery_expiry_one_ck
gallery_expiry_one_ck.value: not ("gallery"."expires_at" is not null and "gallery"."expiry_days" is not null)

gallery_source_label_ck.name: gallery_source_label_ck
gallery_source_label_ck.value: "gallery_source"."label" is null or (char_length("gallery_source"."label") between 1 and 60 and "gallery_source"."label" = btrim("gallery_source"."label"))
